verified_public_facts: BTO/SMP currently provides whole-colony counts through the public database and by data request.
The public SMP data page directs large requests to a Data Request form and provides smp@bto.org as the programme contact.
Current BTO SMP guidance states that zero counts distinguish true absence from a species simply not being surveyed and describes local disappearance as a nil return.
unresolved_provider_specific_hard_stops: Exact semantics of direct Count=0 rows in the delivered bulk extract.
Exact semantics of absent SiteID x species x year rows in the delivered extract.
How estimated/imputed zeroes are encoded and excluded.
Compatible record family / era for those zero semantics.

boundary: Operational readiness only. Public documentation does not replace provider-specific identity and zero-semantics confirmation and does not authorize Stage B.
